evidence: M-O s.v. card suit: hearts, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: The plural of cor, heart; the genitive with a rank: rēx cordium, the king of hearts. Lewis & Short finds the genitive plural cordium only in the Vulgate.

terms.gloss: a heart (one card of the suit)

sources: Lewis & Short: cor
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 51, checked against the searchable text of the book on 11 November 2026.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. card suit: hearts.
